architecture.summary: Fix the existing Brave HTML adapter and result projection so a direct, nonblank inline question is an organic result description. The supported DOM grammar now includes .result-content > .inline-qa-question. The existing Markdown contract still returns safe organic title links and descriptions in source order and excludes separate answer widgets. Public types, origin checks, full-page sanitation before projection, cancellation, resource limits, ownership, dependencies, container boundaries, and deployment stay the same. Equivalent parser loops preserve result validation and exact no-results structure checks. The context, container, component, runtime, and deployment views remain accurate; no registry edit or architecture decision is needed.
